unresolved.reason: The Visit Saudi dataset has separate literal labels for Congo and Democratic Republic of the Congo, but gives both the same explicitly Democratic-Republic-of-the-Congo flag path and noneligible group. Its current frontend uses countryName itself as the selector ID and exposes neither ISO nor another stable sovereign-country identifier. The noneligible OTHER route is an advance Embassy/Consulate/Tasheer route only if the nationality record is exact. Current eVisa terms do not supply a Republic-of-the-Congo crosswalk or a separate consular rule. No current reproducible KSA MFA nationality result corroborates CG, so the DRC-marked result cannot be transferred to a Republic of the Congo ordinary passport.
